penalties.evidence: Buffer status previously read only the first 100 ascending sent records and falsely reported zero Pacific-day sends. On 2026-08-17, the Buffer metric snapshot proved one sent post per YouTube, X, and Instagram channel; cursor pagination now reads all sent history and live readback counts those three posts.

Authoritative Buffer status at 20:34 Pacific, after sent-history pagination repair, counted one sent post on each YouTube, X, and Instagram channel, leaving the three-post daily floor short by two per channel (total deficit six). The checkpoint was late; scheduled-log reconciliation corrected 15 YouTube, 15 X, and 19 Instagram stale entries.

The 2026-08-17 blog queue completed with one explicit quality block: selling-inherited-silver-coins-taxes-and-process is archived under .workflow-blocked/2026-08-17 with qa-local-fail, while three other queue slugs are registered in posts.json.

Three 2026-08-17 registered blog reels pass automated release QA but remain ineligible because manualCaptionReview=false and readyForPosting=false: how-to-value-inherited-silver-for-estate-purposes, local-seo-audit-how-to-do-one-yourself, and service-area-business-seo-guide.
